section: Accidental Deaths and Suicides in India 1994
title: ACCIDENTAL DEATHS & SUICIDES IN INDIA - 1994 N.C.R.B. - 41 1.4.6 APPENDICES-I & II present in details the sex-wise distribution of all causes of 'Accidental Deaths' in various States, UTs and Cities. The trend of male-female fatality ratio 69:31 remained almost the same as of the previous years. From the table below, it is observed that 'Fire Accidents' was the only common cause, which reported more female causality (72.2%) than males (27.8%).
